changelog:
* **docs: group README badges and tidy credits** (cba40fc)
  - Split the single badge row into Project, Tech and Community groups so each wraps cleanly on narrow screens.
  - Space out name, role and Telegram badge in the Credits section so they no longer run together.
* **fix: import layout exclude extension for top bar insets** (2cd0c39)
  - Add the androidx.compose.foundation.layout.exclude import to six screens.
  - TopAppBarDefaults.windowInsets.exclude is an extension function and was unresolved without an explicit import, breaking the release build.
* **refactor: improve screen header hierarchy** (c7ff5ba)
  - Enlarge all top bar titles to 22sp semi-bold and move them 8dp higher.
  - Remove duplicate screen titles under the app bar on Theme, Language, Font and Currency screens.
  - Update section headers (Security, Preview, Backup & Restore etc.) to 16sp semi-bold with tighter spacing.
  - Bump root screen headers (Cash Figure, Settings, History) to the same larger size.
* **fix: stop the picker sheet from filling the screen** (9760300)
  - Overlay the scrollbar with matchParentSize so it no longer
    inflates the wrap-content sheet to full window height.
  - Center the grand total words line under the preview number.
